core: DNA double-strand break sensing and repair pathway choice
qualifier: nonhomologous end joining and its regulation
name: Double-strand break sensing and end-joining repair regulation
rationale: All members concern detecting double-strand breaks (ATM recruitment, PARP-type ADP-ribosylation, chromatin remodeling) and regulating NHEJ versus HR; unlike the confusables it lacks BRCA1/BRCA2 defect and HR resection/strand-invasion steps and centres on end joining.

name: T cell immunological synapse and costimulatory signal assembly
rationale: Members cover T cell polarity, synapse formation, raft localization, CORO1A-DEF6 and CD28-Vav1 signalling complexes; the confusables instead centre on Rho/Cdc42 GTPase cycles or integrin-mediated leukocyte migration.

core: Striated muscle sarcomere assembly and contraction
name: Striated muscle sarcomere, contraction and cardiomyocyte junctions
rationale: Members span myofibril/filament assembly, T-tubules, contraction and stretch sensing plus desmosome and cardiomyocyte cell-cell junctions; confusables lack the junction members and instead carry costamere/DGC, SRF targets or myogenesis development.

name: Mitotic spindle assembly and spindle checkpoint signaling
rationale: All members concern mitotic spindle formation, PLK1 and the MAD2 spindle checkpoint; confusables cover meiosis, chromatid cohesion/condensation, G2/M centrosome kinases or spindle midzone elongation.

name: Th17 commitment and interleukin-17 production and signaling
rationale: Every member is about IL-17 production, IL-17/IL-17A signalling or Th17 commitment; confusables are Th1/Treg, IL-1 family or antifungal C-type lectin programmes.

name: cAMP production and protein kinase A activation
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis (incl. forskolin response), cyclic-nucleotide GPCR coupling and PKA activation; confusables extend to CREB phosphorylation or to adenylate cyclase inhibition rather than PKA activation.

qualifier: presynaptic dopamine synthesis, secretion and reuptake
name: Dopamine synthesis, secretion and reuptake in dopaminergic transmission
rationale: Members concern catecholamine/dopamine biosynthesis, release, uptake transport and dopaminergic synaptic regulation; confusables are SLC6A3 disease, norepinephrine uptake, or postsynaptic dopamine receptor and drug-response behaviour.

name: Di- and tricarboxylate transport and malate-aspartate shuttle
rationale: All members are SLC-mediated transport of succinate, citrate and related organic anions including the malate-aspartate shuttle; the closest confusable shares the transporters but lacks the shuttle and adds pyruvate/alpha-ketoglutarate and kidney members.

qualifier: vestibular gravity sensing and hair cell fate
name: Vestibular gravity sensing and inner ear hair cell fate
rationale: Members cover balance (equilibrioception, vestibular reflex, otoliths, gravity) and hair cell fate and efferent control; confusables are inner ear structural morphogenesis or cochlear sound transduction.

name: Mitochondrial apoptosis execution via BAX/BAK, apoptosome and SMAC
rationale: Members run from BAX/BAK outer-membrane permeabilization and cytochrome c release to apoptosome caspase activation and SMAC antagonism of IAPs; confusables centre on upstream BH3-only protein activation.

name: Light-responsive melanin synthesis and melanocyte proliferation
rationale: Members concern melanin biosynthesis, pigment granule localization, MITF pigmentation genes and melanocyte responses to UV-A/blue light; confusables cover other MITF-M programmes, melanosome biogenesis or organelle acidification and lack the light and proliferation members.

name: IL-2/7/9 and IL-3/5 family cytokine receptor signaling
rationale: All members are class I cytokine receptor signalling for IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-3, IL-5 (and G-CSF inactivation); confusables add IL-15/IL-21, FLT3 or T cell IL-2-STAT5 members and lack the IL-3/IL-5 arm.

qualifier: lymphocyte homing and lymphoid tissue organization
name: Chemokine-directed leukocyte homing and lymphoid tissue organization
rationale: Members are chemokine/S1P/CXCR4-driven chemotaxis of lymphocytes, dendritic and other leukocytes, plus lymph node and mucosal lymphoid tissue development; confusables emphasize T cell extravasation, monocyte CCR2/CX3CR1 recruitment or integrin-mediated migration.

qualifier: G-beta-gamma-gated potassium and calcium channels, presynaptic potential
name: Presynaptic ion channel control of neurotransmitter release
rationale: Members concern presynaptic membrane potential, calcium entry, GIRK activation and G-beta-gamma inhibition of calcium channels shaping vesicle release; confusables cover GPCR-mediated inhibition of secretion, nicotinic receptors or inhibitory synapse assembly.

name: Carnitine, choline and trimethylamine metabolism
rationale: All members concern synthesis, transport or breakdown of carnitine and choline or FMO3 oxidation of trimethylamine; confusables are creatine/phospholipid, sulfur amino acid or S-adenosylmethionine metabolism.

name: Appetite regulation and cAMP-coupled peptide hormone receptor signaling
rationale: Members combine feeding behaviour and appetite control with glucagon, calcitonin/amylin/CGRP, relaxin, somatostatin and ghrelin signalling through adenylate cyclase; confusables are leptin/growth hormone signalling or free fatty acid receptors.

qualifier: NAD and phosphocreatine alongside nucleotide phosphates
name: Nucleotide phosphate, NAD and phosphocreatine energy-carrier metabolism
rationale: Members cover nucleoside di/triphosphate interconversion, mitochondrial ADP/ATP and NAD transport, NAD/nicotinate salvage and creatine/phosphocreatine; confusables centre on mitochondrial apoptosis or nucleoside transport and lack NAD and phosphocreatine.

name: Cytosolic calcium homeostasis via sodium/calcium exchangers
rationale: Members concern cellular calcium handling and lowering cytosolic Ca2+ by Na+/Ca2+ exchange and sequestration; confusables centre on ER/ryanodine calcium release, store-operated entry or cardiac contraction.

core: Mitochondrial respiration and oxidative stress cell death
name: Mitochondrial respiration control and oxidative stress-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate electron transport, OXPHOS, ATP synthesis and ROS and the intrinsic apoptosis triggered by peroxide, hypoxia and osmotic stress; confusables centre on ferroptosis, nitrosative stress and ischemia or calcium-linked muscle apoptosis.

qualifier: isocitrate/NADPH and succinate oxidation to ATP synthesis
name: Tricarboxylic acid cycle, isocitrate/NADPH and succinate oxidation
rationale: Members are TCA intermediates (isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate, succinate, malate), IDH-linked NADPH and 2-hydroxyglutarate, complex II and ATP synthase; confusables centre on 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes, pyruvate/CoA or the malate-aspartate shuttle.

qualifier: N/O-glycan maturation, sialylation, glycosphingolipids, lysosomal catabolism
name: Glycoprotein and glycolipid glycan synthesis, sialylation and degradation
rationale: Nearly all members concern nucleotide-sugar supply, N- and O-glycan processing, sialic acid and fucose, GPI and glycosphingolipid synthesis and their lysosomal breakdown; confusables are proteoglycan/GAG and O-mannosyl glycosylation or early dolichol-linked CDG-I steps.

name: Cholinergic and serotonergic receptor signaling
rationale: Members are acetylcholine (nicotinic, muscarinic, neuromuscular, secretion) and serotonin receptor signalling; confusables involve tachykinin, adenosine/cAMP or histamine and serotonin synthesis/uptake and lack the cholinergic members.

name: Mesenchymal-osteoblast proliferation and collagen matrix production
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation together with collagen, proteoglycan and matrix secretion, tendon and trabecular bone; confusables centre on ossification, RUNX2, mineralization or BMP/TGF-beta programmes.

qualifier: extracellular ATP turnover and cytosolic calcium elevation
name: Purinergic ATP/adenosine signaling and cytosolic calcium elevation
rationale: Members cover P2Y and P1 receptors, ATP export and NTPDase hydrolysis and the resulting calcium rise and CAMKK-AMPK signalling; confusables are KATP channels, other lipid/histamine GPCRs or PLC-coupled signalling.

name: Spliceosomal snRNP biogenesis and alternative splicing regulation
rationale: Members concern spliceosome snRNP assembly, snRNA cap hypermethylation and transport, and regulation of (alternative) splicing; confusables cover core splice-site mechanics with snRNA transcription, 3'-end processing or nuclear RNA decay.
